purpose: AR-06 + offline synthetic Hangul catalog (full_ko_map, jamo retrieval/scoring) submission package, with OOF and noise checks
hypothesis: Jamo similarity against LM-generated Hangul names for all catalog vessels reduces dependence on hand-written lexicons for unseen Hangul vessels.
changed_factors: catalog_full_ko_map.json generated by artifacts/LM-LFM25-FULL-R24-01/model (top-2, first-token branching, prompt catalog-to-observed-name-v2-task-prefix)
artifacts/AS-06/script.py: jamo n-gram primary retrieval, jamo_sim scoring
commands: .\.venv-server\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 artifacts/AS-06/run_ar06.py --data-dir data --eval-dir eval_kit --ko-map AR-06/catalog_full_ko_map.json --exp-id AS-06

metrics.metric_source: oof_AS-06.csv (sha8 f0c43dce) via eval_kit/evaluate.py; LEAKY, not a performance estimate

cost.timing_scope: OOF per-fold predict_rows 54-65s for ~2,400 rows (~25ms/row, use_train_lookup=False); leaderboard infer_sec 302.5 includes catalog build. check_submission: 300 rows incl. lookup hits 6.1s (not representative)

observations: check_submission.py: 0 failures, 0 warnings; row-order/half/single-row independence all 0 differing rows.
OOF uses a ko_map generated by a model trained on all train rows, so OOF is leaky and must not be cited as performance.
Fold-0 clean Hangul is 100% even with ko_map OFF, so the 100% is not explained by the ko_map alone.
Under severe noise, ko_map ON (94.56%) is slightly below OFF (95.40%) on 239 Hangul rows (2 rows).
Default noise: ko_map OFF loses 1 Hangul row (99.58%); ON keeps 100%.
interpretations: No measured evidence that the synthetic catalog improves Hangul accuracy; differences are 1-2 rows of 239 (noisy, single fold, single seed).
limitations: Noise test: fold 0 only, one seed, 239 Hangul rows; matcher fit on folds!=0 but ko_map is leaky.
No leak-free ko_map (per-fold generator) was built; no comparison to AR-06 on identical noisy rows.
Test size (~10k rows) is the user's estimate; server runtime unmeasured.
Official server score not yet available.
decision: Package submit_AS-06.zip passes the format check; submit at the user's discretion. Claim no improvement over AR-06 until a leak-free comparison or an official score exists.
next_actions: Record the official server score and runtime when available.
Optionally build per-fold ko_maps for a leak-free OOF and run AR-06 on the same noisy rows.
